data.long_meaning: Ravi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ravi', which means 'Sun'. Kishan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kishan', which means 'God of all pleasures'. The name RaviKishan carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose RaviKishan usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
